Log expenses (+10 each), keep your daily streak, create groups, settle balances, add family members, finish months under budget and unlock badges.
How do I add an expense by voice?
Tap the mic and say something like “250 groceries by UPI note Diwali shopping”. Amount, category, payment mode and title are filled in; anything after “note” goes into the note.
Can it read my GPay or bank SMS?
Not yet. You can import a CSV from Me → Import CSV. Capturing payments automatically from notifications is on the roadmap.
